text_block_list.text: ――Friday, evening.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Huh, are you sure?! 
Even if we're imposing on you again……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Since this is the final weekend 
before the actual show, 
we will be conducting intensive training 
at our estate as final preparation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu insisted that you all join 
her.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Eh――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Come along.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ――Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We all love racing. The shapes of our 
feelings and goals 
may differ――but this emotion is 
unmistakably "love."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And this "love" is our greatest driving 
force―― 
the very thing that makes us stronger.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. We were overthinking things before, 
but…… 
Ramonu-san's words were actually quite 
literal, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Swearing "love"――just as she said, 
Ramonu-san intends to simply swear her 
"love for racing" at the upcoming Oath 
Ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even when tackling such a brutal training 
menu, 
Ramonu-san was smiling happily every time. 
It was honestly a bit scary at first.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Pure nightmare fuel, truly. ――I shuddered 
at the thought that a menu tough enough to 
make us drop was light enough for her to 
smile through it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
But that's probably not it. Now that I 
understand Ramonu-san's words a bit 
better, I think…… I finally get it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Plowing through a grueling menu means 
you've grown that much stronger. 
And that's definitely something to be 
happy about.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Looking at it that way changes our 
motivation too. 
Just being able to complete the same 
routine as Ramonu-senpai――fills me with 
pride.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Could the beauty routine be based on the 
same reasoning? 
Polishing your…… body?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Who knows…… Whether your skin is glowing 
or not, 
I hardly think it affects the outcome of a 
race, though……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! In the end, Ramonu-san's true 
motives are still mysterious!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
……Still, it's a special opportunity. 
The Oath Ceremony is also the grand reveal 
of our Racewear to a massive audience.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, let's do our best with 
beauty care until then.
――The Day of the Oath Ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hiii! My brilliant little angels―― 
……Wait, oh my?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Is that really you girls…… Cesario-chan, 
Heart-chan…… 
Craft-chan, Messiah-chan……? You've 
transformed so much, I barely recognized 
you……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. They say falling in love makes you 
beautiful! 
――And we've fallen head over heels for 
racing!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Waaao! I see, I see~♪ ……Mm-fufu♡ No wonder 
you've become practically unrecognizably 
gorgeous☆

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Having beauties like you wear my Racewear 
is the greatest joy a designer could ask 
for! Now, you four, time to get changed――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
――Petite fleur. 
It seems those budding spirits have truly 
blossomed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You've polished yourselves splendidly. 
――You look wonderful, all of you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
――! 
Th-Thank you so much……!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You too, Ramonu-chan. ――Utterly 
breathtaking. 
Overwhelming platinum suits you best after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am quite fond of it. 
I saw the track. Thank you for such a 
beautiful――and flawless stage. And also,

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to the final race. 
――Please come at me with everything you 
have.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
――! 
……Are you placing your expectations on us? 
On our running?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh my…… Do you lack confidence? 
In that "love" of yours.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—No! 
I'm running... to defeat you. This time 
for sure."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"—*Chuckle*. 
Very well... That would truly be the most 
beautiful thing of all."
